replies.text:
Automated abuse of a reachable endpoint — design has "The search endpoint takes a free-text query and a sort column from the request"; flooding/expensive queries already covered by listed threat 2 (DoS).
Staff/admin screens showing other people's content — design names no admin, moderation or review screen; not applicable.
Privileged actions with no record (delete, refund, role change, money) — design describes only "builds a SQL statement" for search; no such action; not applicable.
Cacheable personal/financial documents or pages — no documents, accounts or personal data named; deterministic signals show "dataClasses":[], "exposure":"internal"; not applicable.
Attacker text flowing into logs, CSV/spreadsheet exports, emails, headers or another system — design mentions only the request, the statement and "the products database"; no export, log or downstream sink stated; not applicable.
Single-reviewer threats (write/destroy via injection, over-privileged DB account) — listed threat 1 already states the injected fragment lets the attacker "read any table the database user can reach (UNION SELECT), bypass filters, or write", so these are blast-radius consequences of a listed threat, not gaps; privilege-limiting claims also rest on how it "likely" was built, which the design does not state.
